shortDescription: Change the VxRail vCenter server IP address

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: A specific version number to use for the API call. If not included, will use the highest version by default

options.name: gateway
options.description: The new gateway IP for the vCenter Server

options.name: gateway_ipv6
options.description: The new gateway IPv6 for the vCenter Server

options.name: ip
options.description: The new IP address to assign to the vCenter Server

options.name: ipv6
options.description: The new IPv6 address to assign to the vCenter Server

options.name: netmask
options.description: The new subnet mask for the vCenter Server

options.name: prefix_length_ipv6
options.description: The new prefix length for the vCenter Server

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for getting telemetry information, the default value is 300 seconds

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vcroot
options.description: root account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcroot_passwd
options.description: The password for the root account provided in vcroot

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System
